messages:
noah: Hey @people-ops — I'm switching my primary work location from CA to OR effective 2026-04-15. Quick q: how will this affect my WFH stipend proration, payroll/state withholding, and benefits? Do I need to do anything special other than the address change?
people-ops: hey @noah! congrats on the move. short answers: stipend prorates the month you change home base; state withholding will update once payroll gets your new state tax form; benefits generally stay the same but some carriers have regional differences — we'll confirm. please file the Work Base Change form so we can kick off payroll/benefits. link: https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/work-base-change
noah: thanks — filing it now. any deadline to hit so the April 15 date works smoothly?
people-ops: ideally we get the form in by 2026-04-01 so payroll can pick up the withholding changes for the mid-April payrun. if it's after that, the change will apply the following payroll. also let us know if your bank account stays the same.
noah: bank stays the same. also: how do you calculate the stipend proration? is it by calendar days?
people-ops: stipend proration is pro rata by days in the month. example: monthly WFH stipend is $120; if your home base changes on the 15th of a 30-day month, stipend for that month = $120 * (15/30) allocated to the old rate/location vs new. (we don't change the amount for OR vs CA)
noah: got it. what about tax nexus / company obligations — do i need to do anything for my manager or team? will this create a new nexus for Redwood in OR?
people-ops: good question. small delta: individual employee moves normally don't create immediate company nexus in a state unless aggregate activity meets thresholds. payroll/ops will log the move and our tax team monitors aggregate headcount by state. if anything material appears we'll reach out to affected folks. for now, just submit the form and we handle internal tracking.
jenna-payroll: tagging in — @noah please attach a copy/photo of your new lease or utility bill when you submit the form so we can validate the effective address for tax purposes. also confirm whether you need OR state withholding or want to keep CA withholding temporarily (note: keeping CA withholding while working in OR may lead to under/over withholding).
noah: ok will attach lease. is there anything that changes for equity/vesting tax withholding?
maria-benefits: quick note on benefits: most benefits remain identical, but commuter/parking and some local voluntary benefits may differ. if you have dependent coverage and move across state lines, double-check provider networks (especially for mental health/therapy). we can run a quick provider lookup if you share zip.
noah: sharing zip in DM, thanks.
people-ops: to summarize next steps: 1) fill the Work Base Change form: https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/work-base-change 2) attach lease or proof of address 3) indicate bank status and whether you want immediate state withholding change 4) cc your manager on the form so we can update headcount mapping. payroll will confirm cutoff and effective payroll date.
noah: done — form submitted and attached the lease. put "immediate OR withholding" in the note. cc'd my manager.
payroll-bot: Reminder: Work Base Change forms received by 2026-04-01 23:59 PT will be considered for the payroll run on 2026-04-10. Forms submitted after that will apply to the next cycle.
jenna-payroll: got it, I see the form. i'll queue the withholding update; expecting it to hit the 2026-04-10 run. I'll DM if we need more info.
noah: awesome, thanks everyone! :tada:
people-ops: thanks @noah — closing loop here. reach out if anything else pops up.
